data.body: CROSS-ARM CONTAMINATION, FOUND AND CLEANED BEFORE JUDGING. rebar's plan-review checkpoint cache wrote into both pinned checkouts that the other three arms and the judges read: 10 findings-bearing JSON files in one, 12 in the other. Found by the Compound Engineering arm, which reported the directory and correctly declined both to read it and to delete it. THE PATH IS HARDCODED at src/rebar/llm/plan_review/checkpoints.py:37 as repo_root/.rebar/cache/plan-review/<ticket>, and repo_root must be the reviewed checkout, so no environment variable moves it; a prior mitigation believed to redirect it never did, and REBAR_LLM_CACHE_DIR governs a different cache. Exposure: mini proven uncontaminated from its full trajectory (zero occurrences on both runs); CE detected and abstained; superpowers could not be positively cleared from its artifact alone. No finding showed a copying signature. Both trees cleaned and verified at their pinned SHA with zero modifications before any judge started. Correct mitigation is ordering plus cleanup, now recorded in the env script: run rebar first and alone, delete, verify, then the other arms.
